description: AthenaHQ shows how AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini talk about your brand. Ask for share of voice, mention rate, citation rate, and ranking position versus competitors, drill into the AI responses behind those numbers with sentiment and sources, see which domains and pages AI models cite most, and review tracked prompts, competitors, content performance, and plan credit usage for the websites in your AthenaHQ workspace.
